units: <cite ref="Eruvin 64a:4">Erub. 64ᵃ</cite>; <cite ref="Shevuot 46b:4">Shebu. 46ᵇ</cite> <he>שְׂכִירוֹ וכ׳</he>, v. <cite ref="L00687"><he>לָקִיט</he></cite> h.

<cite ref="Mishnah Bava Metzia 9:11">B. Mets. IX, 11</cite> <he>שְׂ׳ יום</he> one hired for day work; <he>ש׳ לילה</he> for night work; <he>ש׳ שעות</he> by hours; <he>ש׳ חדש</he> by the month. Ib. 112ᵇ (in Chald. dict.) <he>עקרוה … ושדיוה אַשָּׂ׳</he> the Rabbis took the oath from the employer, and put it on the hired man. Ib. <he>ש׳ נמי … איתגר</he> the hired man, too, hires himself out from necessity; a. fr.
